name: rubiks-cube-timer
title: Rubiks Cube Timer
description: Time your Rubik's Cube solves with random scrambles and csTimer import/export. No account required.
author: nokoniko

commands.name: rubiks-cube-timer
commands.title: Rubiks Cube Timer
commands.subtitle: Times your solves
commands.description: Get a random scramble and time your solve.

preferences.name: precision
preferences.title: Timer Precision
preferences.description: How finely the running timer counts up. The final time is always exact.

preferences.name: inspection
preferences.title: Inspection
preferences.label: Enable inspection countdown
preferences.description: Enter starts an inspection countdown before the solve. Going over adds +2; going 2s past it is a DNF.

preferences.name: inspectionSeconds
preferences.title: Inspection Time
preferences.description: Length of the inspection countdown in seconds (WCA is 15).
